headline: Qualcomm reports PSS scenario reuse across UVM-agent and embedded-core executors
fact: A Qualcomm Technologies DVCon paper reported using PSS to reuse constrained-random scenario specifications across verification platforms and integration levels. Its executor model maps the same scenario operations either to UVM agents or to embedded processors; the reported fast-platform initialization case changed executor constraints without changing the scenario structure and showed about a 30% average runtime improvement.
